brief: Kosovo's Albanian-language media landscape for banking and payments is dominated by a small set of originating outlets — Buletini Ekonomik (the most systematic monthly restatement of BQK commercial-bank statistics), Telegrafi, KOHA.net, KosovaPress and the investigative KALLXO.com — surrounded by a very large republication layer (Lajmi.net, local portals, Albania-based mirrors such as Monitor.al, Shqiptarja.com, Albeu, JOQ) that recycles the same figures verbatim. Nearly all quantitative reporting traces back to BQK's Albanian press releases and its 'Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë' publication, so BQK's /news/ feed should be treated as the provenance anchor and every media figure matched to it before use. The genuinely additive journalistic value in this cell is event dating, named-official quotes, bank-level product and fee changes (visible in banks' own Albanian 'çmimorja' PDFs), and investigative detail on fraud and AML that aggregates never carry. Main outstanding weaknesses: broadcast economy desks and roughly a dozen further Albanian portals are unconfirmed, Ekonomia Online's domain is unverified, and Serbian-language Kosovo coverage returned nothing in this pass.
